notes: CL=F log returns dropped when current or previous close is non-positive
daily squared close-to-close returns are low-frequency volatility proxies

method.target: next-day close-to-close squared return variance proxy
method.baseline: HAR-style own daily/weekly/monthly log variance lags plus lagged VIX level z-score
method.oil_extension: lagged CL and USO 5-day log-RV shock z-scores plus lagged vol-of-vol z-scores
method.ovx_robustness: adds lagged OVX level and change z-scores
method.lookahead_policy: All forecast features use explicit .shift(1); Granger tests use lagged predictors only.
method.formal_threshold: Harvey-style DM gate requires |t| > 3 and lower OOS QLIKE than baseline.

literature_refs.label: Diebold and Yilmaz (2009), Measuring Financial Asset Return and Volatility Spillovers
Yu (2025), Industry Index Volatility Spillovers and Forecasting from Crude Oil Prices Based on the MS-HAR-TVP Model
Volatility spillovers between oil and financial markets during economic and financial crises

summary.interpretation_guardrail: Forecast evidence uses daily close-to-close squared-return proxies, not intraday realized volatility. Granger/QLIKE results are predictive diagnostics, not structural causality.
